t: The Milwaukee MX4 SDS Plus Masonry Drill Bit is engineered for efficient drilling in tough materials. Ideal for tradespeople installing anchor fixings in brick, concrete, and reinforced concrete. Features an embedded solid one-piece carbide tip with a centering point, ensuring easy spot drilling and extended service life. 4 x symmetrical 90° cutting edges create perfectly round holes and minimise jamming when encountering rebar. High-volume 4-spiral flute geometry provides efficient dust removal, low vibration, and uniform wear for consistent performance consistent performance with SDS Plus rotary hammers.
